title: Red-team evaluation pipeline
summary: Module 6. Turn ad-hoc probing into a repeatable suite. Run every module's attack as one battery, compute attack-success rate in vulnerable vs secure mode, and wire it into CI so a regression fails the build.
takeaway: Security regressions are silent until you test for them. Make the red-team suite part of CI.
design_rule: Re-run every attack as a suite; track attack-success rate; fail the build on regression.
